categories.main_business_segments: Neturen Co., Ltd. operates two main business segments: the Product Business Division and the IH (Induction Heating) Business Division. The Product Business Division manufactures and sells PC steel bars for civil engineering and construction, high-strength spring steel wires for automotive and motorcycle suspension springs, automotive and construction machinery parts. The IH Business Division provides contract heat treatment processing for critical safety parts in automobiles, machine tools, and construction machinery, and manufactures and sells induction heating equipment for various industries. The company also engages in real estate leasing and related research and development activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is induction heating (IH) heat treatment, which is an environmentally friendly and energy-efficient process for hardening and modifying the surface of metal components. Neturen combines advanced high-frequency induction heating with other surface modification techniques, including composite heat treatment, non-oxidizing quenching, and the use of CAE simulation for process optimization. The company also utilizes digital control (FPGA), AI-based inspection systems, and 3D printing for coil manufacturing, supporting both product innovation and production automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Neturen primarily serves customers in the automotive, civil engineering, construction, construction machinery, and machine tool industries. Key end markets include automotive OEMs and suppliers, construction and civil engineering firms, and manufacturers of industrial and construction machinery. The company’s products are critical components in vehicles, infrastructure, and industrial equipment, with a strong focus on high-strength, high-durability applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Neturen operates globally with a strong presence in Japan, China, North America (USA, Mexico), Europe (Czech Republic), and other parts of Asia (South Korea, Indonesia). The company has manufacturing and processing facilities in these regions, and its sales are well-diversified internationally, with significant revenue contributions from Japan, China, North America, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Neturen is positioned both as an upstream and midstream supplier. It manufactures materials and components (such as PC steel bars and spring wires) that are further processed or assembled by its customers, and also provides contract processing (heat treatment) services for critical parts, as well as supplying induction heating equipment to manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on leveraging its IH heat treatment technology to drive environmental sustainability (CO2 reduction), digital transformation (DX), and global market expansion. R&D priorities include developing new materials and processes for EVs, lightweight and high-strength components, automation and AI-driven quality control, and expanding the application of IH technology. Neturen’s long-term vision emphasizes continuous innovation, sustainability, and the creation of new growth drivers through technology and human resource development.
categories.revenue_model: Neturen generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products (PC steel bars, spring wires, automotive and construction machinery parts), contract heat treatment processing services, and the sale of induction heating equipment. The company also earns income from real estate leasing and receives royalties from technology licensing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Neturen is a leading player in the induction heat treatment and high-strength steel products market, competing with other specialized metal processing and materials companies, both domestically and internationally. Its strong technological capabilities, global footprint, and focus on high-value-added applications position it as a technology leader and trusted partner for major automotive and industrial customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Neturen reported consolidated sales of approximately 57.6 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.6 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 1.8 billion yen. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with high equity ratio (71.1%), and aims for medium-term growth to 70 billion yen in sales and 4.6 billion yen in operating profit by FY2027. Recent years have seen stable revenues, with profitability impacted by market conditions and cost pressures, but the company is investing in growth and sustainability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Neturen differentiates itself through its advanced, environmentally friendly IH heat treatment technology, which offers superior energy efficiency, high productivity, and the ability to produce high-strength, durable components. The company emphasizes its ability to provide customized solutions, high quality, and reliability for critical safety and performance applications, as well as its commitment to sustainability and digital transformation. Its global network and technical expertise enable it to respond flexibly to customer needs and industry trends.
